```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

Load dataframes
This is for the detailed phenology and demography sites (TM2, WL1, WL2, WL3, CP2), 
will add BH and YOSE eventually
```{r}
#TM2
TM2_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/TM2_cleaned_all.csv")%>%
  select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#WL1
WL1_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/WL1_cleaned.csv") %>%
  select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#WL2
WL2_16_23 <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/WL2_cleaned_16_23.csv")
WL2_24 <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/WL2_cleaned_24.csv")
WL2_all <- bind_rows(WL2_16_23, WL2_24  %>% mutate(Quad = as.character(Quad), Num_flowers = as.character(Num_flowers))) %>%
        select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#WL3
WL3_all <- read_csv("..//input/Cleaned/WL3_cleaned_all.csv")%>%
  select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#CP2
CP2_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/CP2_cleaned_all.csv") %>%
  select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#BH
BH_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/BH_cleaned_all.csv") %>%
    select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#YOSE1
YOSE1_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/YOSE1_cleaned_all.csv") %>%
    select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#YOSE7
YOSE7_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/YOSE7_cleaned_all.csv") %>%
    select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

#YOSE8
YOSE8_all <- read_csv("../input/Cleaned/YOSE8_cleaned_all.csv") %>%
    select(-Leaf_thickness_mm, -Num_leaves) #leaf thickness and number of leaves only measured at CP2 in 2021 (E. Suglia)

```

Merge dataframes
```{r}
library(janitor)

compare_df_cols(TM2_all, WL1_all, WL2_all, WL3_all, CP2_all, BH_all, YOSE1_all, YOSE7_all, YOSE8_all) #cols match, but structure varies across dataframes


#need to fix column structure mismatches
TM2_all = TM2_all %>%
          mutate(Height_cm = as.numeric(Height_cm)) %>%
          mutate(Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers))%>%
          mutate(Num_fruits = as.numeric(Num_fruits))%>%
          mutate(Year_marked = as.numeric(Year_marked)) %>%
          mutate(Herbivory = if_else(Herbivory == "?", "N", Herbivory)) %>%
          mutate(Herbivory = if_else(Herbivory == "*", "N", Herbivory)) 

WL1_all = WL1_all %>%
          mutate(Transect_plot = as.character(Transect_plot)) %>%
          mutate(Quad = as.character(Quad)) %>%
          mutate(Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm)) %>%
          mutate(Year_marked = as.numeric(Year_marked))%>%
          mutate(Canopy_width_cm = as.numeric(Canopy_width_cm))

WL2_all = WL2_all %>%
          mutate(Num_flowers = if_else(Num_flowers == "(1)?", "1", Num_flowers)) %>%
          mutate(Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers))

WL3_all = WL3_all %>%
          mutate(Transect_plot = as.character(Transect_plot)) %>%
          mutate(Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm))%>%
          mutate(Canopy_width_cm = as.numeric(Canopy_width_cm))



CP2_all = CP2_all %>%
          mutate(Height_cm = as.numeric(Height_cm)) %>%
          mutate(Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm)) %>%
          mutate(Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers))%>%
          mutate(Canopy_width_cm = as.numeric(Canopy_width_cm))

BH_all <- BH_all %>%
    mutate('2018tag' = as.logical('2018tag'),
           '2019tag' = as.logical('2019tag'),
           Buds = as.logical(Buds),
           Quad = as.character(Quad),
           Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers))

YOSE1_all <- YOSE1_all %>%
  mutate(Buds = as.character(Buds),
         Quad = as.character(Quad),
         Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm),
         Height_cm = as.numeric(Height_cm))

YOSE7_all <- YOSE7_all %>%
  mutate(Buds = as.character(Buds),
         Transect_plot = as.character(Transect_plot),
         Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm),
         Num_fruits = as.numeric(Num_fruits),
         Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers),
         Height_cm = as.numeric(Height_cm))

YOSE8_all <- YOSE8_all %>%
  mutate(Transect_plot = as.character(Transect_plot),
         Longest_leaf_cm = as.numeric(Longest_leaf_cm),
         Num_fruits = as.numeric(Num_fruits),
         Num_flowers = as.numeric(Num_flowers))

#check again
compare_df_cols(TM2_all, WL1_all, WL2_all, WL3_all, CP2_all, BH_all, YOSE1_all, YOSE7_all, YOSE8_all) #better.  all numeric columns are the same


#try to bind rows and check errors
alldat = bind_rows(TM2_all, WL1_all, WL2_all, WL3_all, CP2_all, BH_all, YOSE1_all, YOSE7_all, YOSE8_all)

summary(alldat)
```

Add unique plant id based on band color and number,
and the year in which plants were first marked (original census year)
```{r}
alldat = alldat %>%
          filter(!is.na(Band_color), !is.na(Band_num)) %>% #filter to years in which we had numbered bands
          #eventually will need to add in the rest, in which case the x and y coordinates of earlier plants will be the unique identifier.  
          mutate(plant_id = paste(Site, Transect_plot, Quad, Band_color, Band_num, sep = "_")) %>% #add unique id - need to add original census year to plant_id but we use plant_id to determine original census year...
          group_by(plant_id) %>% 
          mutate(original_census_year = min(Census_year)) %>% #add original census year
          ungroup()
write.csv(alldat, "../input/Cleaned/AllSites_cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
I think that is working so far
